import re
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pairs = []
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                nc = c + dc
                if 0 <= nc < w and grid[r + 1][nc] == color:
                    pairs.append((r, c, r + 1, nc, color))
    for r1, c1, r2, c2, color in pairs:
        dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
        before = (r1 - dr, c1 - dc)
        after = (r2 + dr, c2 + dc)
        for start, sr, sc in ((before, -dr, -dc), (after, dr, dc)):
            r, c = start
            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and out[r][c] == background:
                out[r][c] = color
                r += sr
                c += sc
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)

messages=[rec['message']['content'][0]['text'] for rec in records if rec.get('message',{}).get('role')=='user' and 'Demos received' in rec.get('message',{}).get('content',[{}])[0].get('text','')]
parsed=[]
for msg in messages:
    # capture each pair explicitly from headers and following lines
    pair_blocks=re.findall(r'Demo pair \d+ input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \d+ output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance\.|\Z)',msg,re.S)
    for h,w,ib,ob in pair_blocks:
        def rows(block): return [[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in block.strip().splitlines()]
        gi,go=rows(ib),rows(ob)
        parsed.append((gi,go))
print('parsed pairs',len(parsed))
for i,(gi,go) in enumerate(parsed,1):
    pred=ns['transform'](gi)
    print(i, (len(gi),len(gi[0])), pred==go)
